canonical.body: memory.canonical_bytes: UTF-8 finite JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, nesting<=32
canonical.event_bytes: Existing exact Engine+RunWriter envelope {run_id,episode,tick,episode_step,sequence,kind,witness|commit}: sorted spaced ensure_ascii=True JSON plus newline. No case_id envelope member.
canonical.event_reference: SHA256 canonical decoded COMPLETE actual event including sequence; encoding helper does not authenticate event refs.
canonical.input_types: Plain dict/list JSON values only. No arbitrary loader, callback, serializer or body byte parser; unsupported types refuse. Duplicate JSON/member keys must refuse at later raw-reader boundary.

closure_rule: A later external descriptor-only software closure binds this profile and named worker/resolver/helpers/runtime requirements. This profile contains no hash of its new source closure or new source files; no self pin or backward trust-anchor edge.

emission.chain: index count 0/1; previous Context hash at0, persisted earlier witness hash at1; selected input requires count1, pending/not-oracle count0; >=2 refuses. Owner must stop after E/rejection; pure function grants no resumption.
emission.commit: Only future Engine after actual assignment of witnessed returned proposal. Pure Task1 never claims assignment/fsync/commit.
emission.predicate: Exactly one witness iff first valid pending oracle trigger T OR pre-control raised/rejected reached transition/actual returned supervisor failure E; T+E one record.

error_token: Fixed private frozen token: SAME original exception object + captured exact type identity + independent canonical {type,message} bytes. Fixed rethrow helper compares current exception class/message and any Witness projection immediately before rethrow; tamper/oversize/projection failure refuses as infrastructure. Token never serialized as authority.
event_evidence_limit: Task1 checks Ref shapes, distinctness/order/presence and current packet/trigger/actual-circle consistency. Only later independent held-event audit can recompute complete actual event hashes, roles, bodies, placement and tick claims. Schedule alone is not event execution; detected trigger may occur after event tick.
identity_dag: external descriptor-only software closure excluding later trust anchor
accepted source registration/commit/audit/SNP and typed application/M hashes

oracle_binding.authority: Data constructor alone authenticates nothing. Later fixed held-source consumer must prove actual SNP/source event geometry equals registered profile and maintain source custody.
oracle_binding.geometry: Before uses fixed source-world audit geometry, conditional on later placement proof. After must equal Reach.actual_circles and the sole exact allowed realized edit; refs cannot authenticate actual intervention bodies. No future geometry lookup at an unreached trigger.
oracle_binding.no_fresh_passage: Every reached packet event..decision inclusive, including terminal sensed packet, requires unobserved passages. No-event no selector/resolver.
oracle_binding.resolver: Fixed gold_target_ids(authenticated acquired source M, before occupancy, actual reached after occupancy, actual detector trigger); ordinary selector still receives unchanged live M once.
oracle_binding.source_m: Exactly acquired two observed-open facts, current episode evidence not later than source-world last_tick, stable IDs/subjects/kind/associations/inspection mapping equal bound case; Context authenticates source M separately through later held custody.
oracle_binding.source_world: Existing validated state2 from application.world_task_state, unarmed, applied false, last_tick=boundary-1, matching case/hash; detached canonical bytes only, no callable/member setters.
oracle_binding.trigger_window: First actual detector trigger may be later than event tick, but must occur no later than decision boundary; new/late/second trigger refuses before selection.

physical_accounting: Every original/control/candidate/final Context copy charged to shared1MiB overhead and full stage/lifetime peaks; Witness/Commit in raw and each copied events file charged inside5MiB condition events. No free reserve, compression, deletion credit or pruning; actual complete admission closed.
reach_nullable_rule: before_occupancy/after_occupancy nonnull only when this transition resolved oracle gold. All nonoracle transitions, pretrigger/no-event and later terminal without new oracle resolution require both null, even if nonoracle ordinary trigger/selection occurred. Task3 independently reconstructs actual occupancy from held source/case/raw geometry; no nonoracle evaluator binding.

result_rule.idempotent: Detached strict4 input and cursor bearing, decisions empty, equal detached Lifecycles, no witness/error or second calls
result_rule.ordinary-return: Detached proposed strict4 state/bearing/actual decisions; lifecycles; no witness/error; not idempotent
result_rule.raised: No proposed state/bearing; returned decisions empty; captured actual local hashes and Lifecycles, raised Witness, original opaque error token
result_rule.rejected: Infrastructure error, no proposed state/bearing, decisions empty. No witness for prevalidation/cap/serialization/index failures; bounded postvalidation reached refusal has exact local rejected Witness/stage prefix. Never a scientific 900 or resume permission.
result_rule.witnessed-return: Same local proposals with returned Witness, no error; returned supervisor failure included; no Engine commit claim

scope: Task1 pure source/schema software only; no actual source, model, native, publication, allocation, scientific qualification or adoption authority.

size_proof.commit_derivation: Fixed schema,3 outer H, bounded tick and Lifecycle<=3 H, canonical run UUID plus exact Engine episode/tick/episode_step/sequence/kind: complete event<=2048.
size_proof.context_derivation: 6 descriptors<=768 bytes each with nonescaping paths<=512 bytes; all remaining fixed fields/IDs/hashes/schedule<=3584; total<=8192<16384.
size_proof.exception_derivation: Each <=512 UTF8 bytes; ensure_ascii worst expansion per input byte <=6; 2*512*6=6144. Controls attain6x. No truncation.
size_proof.float_derivation: At most60 finite binary64 coordinates; shortest round-trip needs <=17 significant decimal digits, sign/dot/exponent notation <=24 JSON chars each; <=1440 plus bounded counters/delimiters within2048.
size_proof.hash_derivation: At most25 quoted H values: 7 outer +4 refs +8 stages +6 Lifecycles; 25*66=1650<=2048 (overapproximate mutually exclusive lifecycle/stage cases).
size_proof.id_derivation: 4 occupancy keys +5 trigger IDs +selection event/target +gold +canonical envelope run UUID: <=12*128+36=1572<=2048. Engine envelope has no case_id; all3 exact counters are bounded. Other schema/enum text belongs in fixed category.
size_proof.oversize_policy: One-byte-over shape or complete event cap refuses before owner continuation; incompatible inputs block adoption, never outcome-based dropping.
size_proof.status: Authored symbolic shape and unchanged RunWriter serializer verification only; not actual corpus convertibility or runtime/admission qualification.

stage_rule: Ordered once-only prefix trigger,resolved,installed,selected only for oracle first trigger. Partial evaluator transaction only rejected infrastructure. Stage hashes bind exact objects at each logical cut; no extra selector calls or generic hook.

state.arm: Only existing continuation_start_tick and decision_tick changes; no unarmed-equality claim after arm.
state.exact_keys: legacy strict3 STATE_FIELDS plus terminal_context_sha256 and terminal_lifecycle
state.legacy_public_admission: Strict3 remains unchanged; all direct state4 calls refuse. No public 4-to-3 transition projection.

lifecycle.pending: all three hashes null, syntactic empty resource and acyclic pending provenance
lifecycle.selected: all three hashes lowercase H; resource/provenance equal installed selector, selection hash of selection itself

state.source_invariant: Original3 application hash before Context; no native/world/RNG normalization. Full absent application/source truth remains later held-source responsibility.

types.actual_circles: Plain list of <=20 plain lists of exactly3 finite built-in float (binary64) coordinates, positive radius. Integers, bools, tuples and nonfinite values refuse before transition; legacy _numbers remains unchanged.
types.descriptor_path: 1..512 ASCII bytes [A-Za-z0-9._/-]; components nonempty and not . or ..; no leading/trailing/repeated slash
types.descriptor_size: Exact nonnegative integer under proposed wire ceiling: source_snapshot<=16777216, other Context metadata descriptors<=1048576. This does not relax stricter inherited role-specific caps at later held-source admission (e.g. commit16KiB, conversion64KiB) or shared overhead1MiB. Software closure is descriptor-only, distinct from separate runtime-reference manifests.
types.engine_envelope_counters: episode exact int0; tick and episode_step exact ints0..2100, both equal body.tick. Bounded single-episode source custody must independently establish actual equal counters; no caller permission flags.
types.event_sequence: Exact int 0..49999; prior distinct refs before sensed event
types.id: [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]*; 1..128 ASCII bytes, successor only; legacy broader IDs unchanged
types.run_id: Canonical lowercase hyphenated UUID, source and condition distinct
